Package com.example.lotterize.ui.addEvents.ChosenEntrantsList

Class ChosenEntrantsListFragment

Fragment
com.example.lotterize.ui.addEvents.ChosenEntrantsList.ChosenEntrantsListFragment
public class ChosenEntrantsListFragment extends Fragment
ChosenEntrantsListFragment displays the list of chosen entrants for a given event.

It listens to changes on the corresponding events/{eventId} document and:

  • Shows all entrants in the selectedList field of the event.
  • Marks entrants in finalList as enrolled and non-removable.
  • Allows the organizer to move a chosen entrant to cancelledList via a "Remove" action.
The fragment uses ChosenEntrantsArrayAdapter to render each entrant row.
